summary: Overnight sweep, 10 wants. The $800 Warn Zeon sold within 14 hours, which says the used Warn end of the winch market clears fast. A Stihl MS 461 at $1,000 in Werribee is now the cheapest 30in-capable saw on the list. The Pickles 2021 Kubota M108S loader at Mildura opens for bidding Monday morning and closes Tuesday evening. Everything else held at the same prices.
headlines: Warn Zeon 10-S at $800 sold within 14 hours. Warn VR Evo 10-S in Tatura is now the best live winch, cut to $900, postable.
New: Stihl MS 461, full service kit, two spare chains, $1,000 at Werribee, 30km. Cheapest 30in-capable saw so far.
Pickles 2021 Kubota M108S loader, 3,621 hrs, Mildura 390km: bidding opens Mon 12 Oct 9am, closes Tue 13 Oct 6:30pm AEDT.
New: Pawzy 120 x 75 cm gel cooling mat, boxed, $39 at Camberwell, 10km. The $15 Yarraville mat is still up.
New: Massey Ferguson single-tine ripper $350 at Bendigo, 310km. Zannit and Heavy Haul plant trailers downgraded: 3.5 t rating, too light for a tractor.
No price moves elsewhere. Grays Shepparton 2-bed container house still $22,000 with no bids, closes Wed 15 Oct 9:40pm.
